Name: Luck Vortex
Information:
**Luck Vortex**

Luck vortexes are bundles of karma and space given shape and form, commonly forming on the Astral Sea within its improbable depths, or by an arcanist attempting to seize control of fate. Luck vortexes react to the fortune and favor of those around them, feeding on or dying by their karma’s fickle pulse.

traits.name: Luck Lost Gained
traits.description: When a non-elemental creature targeting the elemental with an attack does so with advantage, the elemental gains 11 (2d10) hit points. If they roll with disadvantage, the elemental takes 11 (2d10) damage that cannot be reduced. Additionally, if the attack scores a critical hit, it automatically misses, and a d20 result of 1 causes it to automatically hit and double its dice as though it was a critical hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two Fatestab attacks.

actions.name: Fatestab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) psychic damage. When this attack hits a target for the first time on its turn, flip a coin. On a result of heads, all of the elemental’s attacks have advantage until the end of the turn. On tails, it has disadvantage on all of its attacks until the end of its turn.
